tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search AI building blocks on Stackmark by keyword, optionally limited to one type. Returns the most relevant listings first, with IDs for get_listing.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one listing as Markdown: description, type, source, license, popularity, links, similar listings and a comparison table.

tools.name: similar_listings
tools.description: Up to 5 listings of the same type that are most similar to the given one; useful for finding alternatives.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The types of building blocks on Stackmark, with how many public listings each has.
